description: Get an entire discussion thread, all entries and nested replies, in one request. Read-only. Much lighter on rate limits than paging through list_entries. All participant text is fenced as untrusted.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of discussion entries to include.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: get_full_topic_view
title: Get Full Topic View
